The only place the password is used is in the libcurl options; no system(), exec(), popen() or other OS command execution primitives appear in the code. The reported sink "read_data_callback" (lines 16‑35) merely copies email body data into a buffer and never invokes any external command. Therefore there is no path from the attacker‑controlled password to an OS command execution. The source is plausible, but the sink is unrelated, so the claim of OS Command Injection is invalid.
